<a class="hub-question-row" href="query-only-routing.qmd">
<strong>How far can query-only routing go?</strong>
<span>Can a new request be routed well by comparing it with historical requests, before using candidate responses?</span>
<span><strong>Current bounded answer</strong> Dense query neighbors are a useful stable control, but candidate-side evidence improved development results.</span>

<span>When a generated answer guides candidate comparison, when is it trustworthy enough and when should it be reviewed?</span>
<span><strong>Current bounded answer</strong> Gemini was the strongest reviewed default, but difficult and ambiguous cases still need selective escalation.</span>
